summary: Parsing truncated strftime padding modifiers "%_", "%-", or "%0" panics because the tokenizer indexes the missing third byte. The fix checks that byte with get(2) and returns InvalidFormatDescription::Expected for a valid escape sequence at index 2. The fix adds the selected parameterized regression test in time/tests/integration/parse_format_description.rs; its integration target is "tests" and requires --all-features. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: index out of bounds: the len is 2 but the index is 2
